title: Available skills
configure: Configure skills in the global config.yaml. Project skills require an exact project path in skills.trustedProjects. Restart to reload.
permissionHint: Use the /permission menu to change the approval mode for this session.

market.title: Skills marketplace
market.description: Browse skills on this computer and in shared directories, or add skills from a package or link.
market.newSession: Newly installed skills are loaded when a new session is created. Existing sessions keep their current skills.
market.drop: Choose a ZIP file or drop it here
market.zipHint: Up to 10 MB. Include SKILL.md and any supporting files.
market.linkHint: Supports public GitHub repositories and skill folders, skills.sh links, and HTTPS links to ZIP files or SKILL.md. A direct SKILL.md link imports that file only.
market.trustHint: This project is not trusted. Installation is allowed, but skills will stay unavailable until the project is added to skills.trustedProjects in config.yaml and the CLI reconnects.
market.installHint: Use sources you trust. Installation saves files without running scripts. Existing skills are never overwritten.
market.noProjectHint: Open this web workspace from the AlphaCode CLI to browse and install skills.
market.noMatchesHint: Try another search or select all sources.
market.emptyHint: Add a ZIP package or paste a skill link to get started.

reason.disabled: This skill or its directory is disabled in config.yaml.
reason.untrusted: Add this project to skills.trustedProjects in config.yaml and reconnect the CLI to use its skills.
reason.reserved: This name is reserved for a built-in command.
reason.shadowed: Another skill with the same name takes precedence in this project.

errors.unavailable: The current backend does not provide the skills API. After upgrading, close all AlphaCode CLI clients and web tabs, wait about 60 seconds for the old server to exit, then restart AlphaCode and open /web.
errors.conflict: A skill with this name already exists, or the package contains duplicate names. Choose another directory or rename the skill before importing.
errors.size: The package is too large. ZIP files must be at most 10 MB, with at most 40 MB and 2,048 entries after extraction.
errors.url: Use a public HTTPS skill link. Local network addresses and URLs with credentials are not supported.
errors.download: Could not download this skill. Check that the link is public and reachable, or upload its ZIP package.
errors.package: No valid skill package was found. Check SKILL.md names, descriptions and supported fields. Packages may contain up to 32 skills without nested skills or reserved command names.
errors.archive: This ZIP file could not be imported. Use a valid, unencrypted ZIP without symbolic links, duplicate paths or unsafe file names.
errors.directory: This installation directory is unavailable. Choose an enabled directory without symbolic links.
errors.project: This project is no longer available. Refresh the page and reconnect from the CLI.
errors.request: Could not reach the skills service. Refresh the list to check whether installation completed before trying again.
